decisions.reason: The particle therapy water phantom is a strategic high-value system, with its release still scheduled for Q1/2019, so it is very unlikely to be withdrawn this early.
Small volume chambers are core dosimetry products with long lifecycles that support small-field and stereotactic QA demand.
A newly launched small volume chamber fits the firm's dosimetry portfolio and typically stays on the market for many years.
Standard clinical ionization chambers are staple reference products with steady demand from calibration and routine QA.
Relative dosimetry chambers pair with the firm's water phantoms and scanning systems, which secures ongoing sales.
Thimble chambers are long-lived workhorse products backed by accredited calibration services, so dropping one shortly after launch is unlikely.
